study: Power bar off the anchor line (operator-pasted YouTube setup #3, same presenter, 2026-10-23): on 2-minute bars, a large mostly-body candle that BEGINS at or near the 20-period SMA ('anchor line'), CLEARS resistance to the left, with the SMA flat or rising; enter as it closes, stop beyond the bar; target 2R.
registered_at: 2026-10-23, before any script, feature or outcome
origin: Operator pasted the transcript: QQQ and NVDA examples on one day; the presenter 'stacks' a W pattern (information only here) and notes 'open lower and bounce' streaks (discretionary, not tested).
prior: LOW (~10%): MA pullbacks (EMA pullback, Grok recipe) and breakouts each failed here; this is their combination with a large-body trigger.
instruments: PRIMARY: SPY and QQQ, long. INFORMATION: warehouse stocks (liquid names, 110 sessions), long, 5 bp.
data: SIP 1-minute RTH bars for SPY and QQQ 2016-01-04 .. 2026-10-15 (shared with fence_bar), data-only account; warehouse for stocks.

rule.bars: 2-minute bars on America/New_York clock boundaries from 09:30, from 1-minute bars (both present).
rule.anchor: SMA20 = mean of the last 20 two-minute closes (continuing across sessions; dropped sessions skipped); A_prev = SMA20 through the bar BEFORE the candidate.
rule.power_bar: RANGE >= 2.0 x the median 2-minute range of the previous session's RTH bars; BODY >= 60% of the range; close > open; close in the top 20% of the range.
rule.at_anchor: the candidate's LOW <= A_prev x 1.001 and its OPEN <= A_prev x 1.0015 (it begins at or near the anchor line).
rule.clears_left: close > the highest high of the previous 15 two-minute bars of the same session (needs 15 bars: first candidate 10:00).
rule.slope: SMA20 through the candidate >= A_prev (flat or rising).
rule.window: candidate bars ending 10:00 .. 15:29; one open trade per symbol; at most 3 trades per symbol-day.
rule.entry: the open of the first 1-minute bar after the candidate ends.
rule.stop: candidate low - $0.01; fill min(stop, bar open); the entry minute's high/low is checked; both-touch = stop.
rule.target: 2R: entry + 2 x (entry - stop), needs high >= target + $0.01; fill at target (or bar open if above).

control: For each trade, a seeded random entry minute in (candidate end + 1) .. (candidate end + 60) on the same symbol-day (seed 'apb-ctrl'), same percent stop and target, same exits; 'apb-ctrl2' for the MDE.
cost: 2 bp binding for SPY/QQQ; 1, 5, 10 printed; stocks 5 bp.
primary: Long trades on SPY + QQQ. Per half: per day mean of (a) trade net, (b) trade minus control; day-equal; day-clustered t.
pass: In BOTH halves: long net (after 2 bp) > 0 with t >= 2.0 (vs 0), AND long minus control >= +5 bp point estimate with t >= 2.0 (vs 0), AND dropping the 3 best days keeps both >= 0. Batch-robust: t >= 2.84 both halves.
fail: t <= -2 on either primary quantity in a half, or the 97.5% upper bound of long minus control below +5 bp in both halves; otherwise UNDERPOWERED.
power: Outcome-blind count step: >= 300 long-trade days per half; MDE = (2.0 + 0.84) x SD(day mean control - control2) / sqrt(days) <= 5 bp; else UNDERPOWERED.
information_only: a W pattern before the bar
exit at a close below SMA20 instead of 2R
no_retuning: All thresholds above, halves, cost and floors are fixed.
declared_deviations: 'mostly body, larger than the candles around it', 'at or near', 'resistance to the left' are discretionary; the numbers above are the mechanical reading fixed before data
exits are discretionary in the video (2R, the 20, an 8 EMA, patterns); 2R is the registered one
desk runs on IEX with no ETF trade path; a PASS goes only to a forward paper prereg

amended.when: 2026-10-23, after result-skeptic round 1 FIX FIRST, before any script or data.
changes: (1) CONTROL window = (candidate end + 1) .. min(candidate end + 60, 15:30); if empty the trade is dropped and counted.
(2) AT_ANCHOR replaced: |candidate open - A_prev| <= 0.15% x A_prev AND candidate low <= A_prev x 1.001.
(3) SKIP (counted): entry open <= stop or >= target.

(4) SIZE TEST REPLACED: RANGE >= 2.0 x the median range of the SAME clock 2-minute bar over the prior 10 kept sessions (needs >= 5 of them; else no candidate that bar). Dropped early-close sessions are not kept sessions.
(5) RE-ENTRY: candidates while a trade in that symbol is open are ignored and counted; controls are drawn only for trades taken.
Batch-robust bar t >= 2.84; floors and MDE per its own 'power' text (>= 300 long-trade days per half).
